name: Modules.CoreMotion.DeviceMotion
summary: Allows Titanium client applications to access CoreMotion's DeviceMotion APIs.

methods.name: availableAttitudeReferenceFrames
methods.summary: Returns a bitmask specifying the available attitude reference frames on the device.

methods.name: getAttitudeReferenceFrame
methods.summary:
Returns either the reference frame currently being used or the default 
attitude reference frame.
methods.description:
If device motion is active, this property returns the reference frame currently in use. 
If device motion is not active but has been active since the app was last launched, 
this property returns the last frame used. If device motion has not been active since 
the app was last launched, this property returns the default attitude reference frame 
for the device.
Possible reference frames include 
[Modules.CoreMotion.ATTITUDE_REFERENCE_FRAME_X_ARBITRARY_Z_VERTICAL](api:Modules.CoreMotion#ATTITUDE_REFERENCE_FRAME_X_ARBITRARY_Z_VERTICAL), 
[Modules.CoreMotion.ATTITUDE_REFERENCE_FRAME_X_ARBITRARY_CORRECTED_Z_VERTICAL](api:Modules.CoreMotion#ATTITUDE_REFERENCE_FRAME_X_ARBITRARY_CORRECTED_Z_VERTICAL), 
[Modules.CoreMotion.ATTITUDE_REFERENCE_FRAME_X_MAGNETIC_NORTH_Z_VERTICAL](api:Modules.CoreMotion#ATTITUDE_REFERENCE_FRAME_X_MAGNETIC_NORTH_Z_VERTICAL), and
[Modules.CoreMotion.ATTITUDE_REFERENCE_FRAME_X_TRUE_NORTH_Z_VERTICAL](api:Modules.CoreMotion#ATTITUDE_REFERENCE_FRAME_X_TRUE_NORTH_Z_VERTICAL).

methods.name: getDeviceMotion
methods.summary: Returns the latest sample of device-motion data.
methods.description:
An app that is receiving device-motion data after calling 
[Modules.CoreMotion.DeviceMotion.startDeviceMotionUpdatesUsingReferenceFrame](api:Modules.CoreMotion.DeviceMotion#startDeviceMotionUpdatesUsingReferenceFrame) or
[Modules.CoreMotion.DeviceMotion.startDeviceMotionUpdates](api:Modules.CoreMotion.DeviceMotion#startDeviceMotionUpdates) with no callback, need to periodically
check the value returned by this method and process the device-motion data.

methods.name: isDeviceMotionActive
methods.summary: Returns a Boolean value that determines whether the app is receiving updates from the device-motion service.
methods.description:
Indicates whether [Modules.CoreMotion.DeviceMotion.startDeviceMotionUpdates](api:Modules.CoreMotion.DeviceMotion#startDeviceMotionUpdates) or 
[Modules.CoreMotion.DeviceMotion.startDeviceMotionUpdatesUsingReferenceFrame](api:Modules.CoreMotion.DeviceMotion#startDeviceMotionUpdatesUsingReferenceFrame) has been called since 
[Modules.CoreMotion.DeviceMotion.stopDeviceMotionUpdates](api:Modules.CoreMotion.DeviceMotion#stopDeviceMotionUpdates).

methods.name: isDeviceMotionAvailable
methods.summary: Returns a Boolean indicating whether device-motion is available on the device.

methods.name: setDeviceMotionUpdateInterval
methods.summary: The interval in milliseconds, for providing device-motion updates to the callback.
methods.description:
The system supplies device-motion updates to the callback passed to 
[Modules.CoreMotion.DeviceMotion.startDeviceMotionUpdatesUsingReferenceFrame](api:Modules.CoreMotion.DeviceMotion#startDeviceMotionUpdatesUsingReferenceFrame) or
[Modules.CoreMotion.DeviceMotion.startDeviceMotionUpdates](api:Modules.CoreMotion.DeviceMotion#startDeviceMotionUpdates) at regular intervals 
determined by the value passed to this method. The interval units 
are in milliseconds. The value of this property is capped to minimum 
and maximum values; the maximum value is determined by the maximum 
frequency supported by the hardware. If your app is sensitive to the 
intervals of device-motion data, it should always check the timestamps 
of the delivered device-motion event to determine the true update interval.

methods.name: setShowsDeviceMovementDisplay
methods.summary: Controls whether the device-movement display is shown.
methods.description:
When a device requires movement (for example, to calibrate the compass), the value of 
this property indicates if the system's device-movement display should be shown. 
When a device requires movement, the callback for 
[Modules.CoreMotion.DeviceMotion.setDeviceMotionUpdateInterval](api:Modules.CoreMotion.DeviceMotion#setDeviceMotionUpdateInterval) or 
[Modules.CoreMotion.DeviceMotion.startDeviceMotionUpdatesUsingReferenceFrame](api:Modules.CoreMotion.DeviceMotion#startDeviceMotionUpdatesUsingReferenceFrame) reports 
the [Modules.CoreMotion.ERROR_DEVICE_REQUIRES_MOVEMENT](api:Modules.CoreMotion#ERROR_DEVICE_REQUIRES_MOVEMENT) error once. By default, 
this is set to false.

parameters.name: show
parameters.summary: Boolean indicating if the display should be shown

methods.name: startDeviceMotionUpdates
methods.description:
If a callback is passed to this method, it will be called whenever there is an update.
The frequency of these updates can be controlled using the 
[Modules.CoreMotion.DeviceMotion.setDeviceMotionUpdateInterval](api:Modules.CoreMotion.DeviceMotion#setDeviceMotionUpdateInterval) method.
If no callback is passed, the device-motion data can be accessed using the 
[Modules.CoreMotion.DeviceMotion.getDeviceMotion](api:Modules.CoreMotion.DeviceMotion#getDeviceMotion) method. To stop the delivery of events, 
call the [Modules.CoreMotion.DeviceMotion.stopDeviceMotionUpdates](api:Modules.CoreMotion.DeviceMotion#stopDeviceMotionUpdates) method.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.summary: The method to be called when there is an update.

inlined.name: CoreMotionDeviceMotionDataWithSuccess
inlined.summary:
Dictionary passed to the callback of the
[Magnetometer.startDeviceMotionUpdates()](Modules.CoreMotion.Magnetometer.startDeviceMotionUpdates) and
[Magnetometer.startDeviceMotionUpdatesUsingReferenceFrame()](Modules.CoreMotion.Magnetometer.startDeviceMotionUpdatesUsingReferenceFrame) methods.

properties.name: code
properties.summary: An error code describing the error if there was one.

properties.name: error
properties.summary: An error message describing the error if there was one.

properties.name: success
properties.summary: A Boolean indicating if the operation was successful or not.

methods.name: startDeviceMotionUpdatesUsingReferenceFrame
methods.summary: Starts device-motion updates using a reference frame.
methods.description:
If a callback is passed to this method, it will be called whenever there is an update.
The frequency of these updates can be controlled using the 
[Modules.CoreMotion.DeviceMotion.setDeviceMotionUpdateInterval](api:Modules.CoreMotion.DeviceMotion#setDeviceMotionUpdateInterval) method.
If no callback is passed, the device-motion data can be accessed using the 
[Modules.CoreMotion.DeviceMotion.getDeviceMotion](api:Modules.CoreMotion.DeviceMotion#getDeviceMotion) method. To stop the delivery of events, 
call the [Modules.CoreMotion.DeviceMotion.stopDeviceMotionUpdates](api:Modules.CoreMotion.DeviceMotion#stopDeviceMotionUpdates) method.
